## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology); confirmatory signals: uniform sector weakness across all 11 sectors and a patchwork of large-cap trends (several Tech names ABOVE TREND while other mega-caps show TREND EXHAUSTION or BELOW TREND).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology (relative leader): AMAT (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +1.11%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary showing isolated strength: RCL (1W: +15.44% | 1M: -0.48%) RECOVERY, BKNG (1W: +4.50% | 1M: -17.98%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples weak: WMT (1W: -5.98% | 1M: -0.91%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND. Industrials and Materials lag with BA (1W: -6.94% | 1M: -10.46%) BELOW TREND and NEM (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -8.31%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: RCL (1W: +15.44% | 1M: -0.48%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, BKNG (1W: +4.50% | 1M: -17.98%) RECOVERY, SHOP (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +0.63%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) and style mixed / no clear leadership given broad sector weakness.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: IBM (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -5.98% | 1M: -0.91%) BELOW TREND, SLB (1W: -6.07% | 1M: -18.51%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -8.31%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: RCL (1W: +15.44%), AMAT (1W: +7.80%), LRCX (1W: +6.91%), BKNG (1W: +4.50%), SHOP (1W: +4.19%). Major divergence present (AAPL, META, QCOM, BKNG among large caps with 1W ≠ 1M) — major divergence implies watch for trend break and tempers strong regime calls.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed internals with pockets of strength but notable exhaustion: AMAT (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +1.11%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +5.10%) CORRECTION, QCOM (1W: -6.69% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION — Sector breadth: 0/11 sectors positive, Technology (24 stocks) showing internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Broadly weak and below trend: JPM (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -7.08%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -5.28%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -6.42%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W performance negative and offers limited confirmation for risk-on.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed defensiveness but soft weekly flows: LLY (1W: +0.53% | 1M: +0.03%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +3.80% | 1M: -1.95%) RECOVERY, JNJ (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: weak (0/11 sectors positive overall) and rotation within names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to names showing confirmed strength (AMAT, LRCX, MSFT) and reduce exposure to structurally weak, below-trend names (WMT, SLB, BA). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration and universal sector weakness; treat recent recoveries as tactical, not broad trend confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +0.63%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -6.69% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION, BA (1W: -6.94% | 1M: -10.46%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -13.49%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (watch AMAT/LRCX follow-through; Technology (24 stocks) internal rotation). BEARISH: Consumer Staples and Industrials (both showing pronounced weekly weakness and below-trend leadership).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
AMAT above-trend continuation: watch follow-through above recent highs (AMAT (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND). AAPL correction pivot: monitor 1M support test (AAPL (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +5.10%) CORRECTION). QCOM downside risk on momentum failure (QCOM (1W: -6.69% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GOOGL (+55): Google AI Gemini 4 Argon reveal; GOOGL (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +1.46%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment largely confirming modest price strength. BA (+60): $20B fighter contract; BA (1W: -6.94% | 1M: -10.46%) BELOW TREND — bullish headline but price diverging (distribution). AMZN (+50): $1B Synopsys deal for AWS; AMZN (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -4.09%) BELOW TREND — positive news but price not confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MSFT (-45): valuation critique; MSFT (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +1.11%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from price, monitor for distribution. F (-50): weak sales headline; F (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -13.49%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. BA appears in both lists (+60 bullish headline) but price BELOW TREND — treat as headline-driven without price confirmation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMAT, LRCX, MSFT showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND) while AAPL, QCOM and several cyclicals show TREND EXHAUSTION or BELOW TREND. Major divergence across large caps and mixed sentiment (MSFT headlines negative but price intact; BA headlines positive yet price weak) — watch for trend confirmation before broad repositioning.
